title: Replace header/footer logo with production-ready transparent asset

requirements.summary: Add a production-ready transparent-background GARUDAYA logo asset under the generated public assets folder.
acceptanceCriteria: A new transparent-background logo image exists under frontend/public/assets/generated.
The new logo is web-friendly (crisp, cropped to remove excessive whitespace, and sized consistently with the current logo usage).

file_operations.description: Add the cleaned, production-ready transparent-background logo wordmark for GARUDAYA PRIVATE LIMITED (crisp, tightly cropped to remove excess whitespace, and suitable for web usage at typical header/footer sizes).

requirements.summary: Update header and footer to use the new transparent logo and ensure it displays clearly without distortion in light and dark themes.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/site/SiteHeader.tsx uses the new transparent logo src path.
frontend/src/components/site/SiteFooter.tsx uses the new transparent logo src path.

Logo preserves aspect ratio (no distortion) and remains clearly visible in header/footer across light and dark theme backgrounds (e.g., via correct sizing and, if needed, a subtle container/background behind the logo).

file_operations.description: Replace the current logo src (garudaya-logo-white-bg.dim_1200x300.png) with /assets/generated/garudaya-logo-transparent.dim_1200x300.png and adjust the logo/container styling to ensure: (1) preserved aspect ratio (e.g., w-auto/object-contain), (2) no stretching, and (3) clear visibility/contrast on both light and dark header backgrounds (add a subtle background/overlay behind the logo only if needed).

Replace the current logo src (garudaya-logo-white-bg.dim_1200x300.png) with /assets/generated/garudaya-logo-transparent.dim_1200x300.png and adjust the logo/container styling to ensure: (1) preserved aspect ratio (e.g., w-auto/object-contain), (2) no stretching, and (3) clear visibility/contrast on both light and dark footer backgrounds (add a subtle background/overlay behind the logo only if needed).
